reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the exact source and NEAREST 8x detail including the note crop, complete unchanged current raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; compared the note, wrap, hair, brows, neckline, tab and backing, with generation and evidence bindings checked by the review recorder.

remaining_reasons: The source has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in EACH of its two note rows. External-04 substitutes a long continuous horizontal bar for the upper-right irregular group and regular dot/dash clusters elsewhere. Restore only the source's two irregular groups per row with their original relative lengths, separation and compact footprint; no long bars, generic dots or invented writing. Retain the restored small right-edge tab and blank lower paper without the old long creases.

hair_features.reason: The dark swept-back hair beneath the purple patterned wrap, thin dark brows, smooth chin and absence of added facial hair remain.

collar_fit.reason: The dark burgundy neckline knot and single strand of white beads remain, with a short broad transition to the rounded chin and no pinched or floating collar.

entries.positive_observation: The purple patterned head wrap and blouse, dark hair, brows, green-ringed eyes, one mouth and single white bead strand remain. The complete blue-charcoal backplate, small dark right-edge tab and mostly blank lower note remain; white/cyan/alpha viewing shows no visible interior holes or lost backing.
entries.alpha_decision: The native exterior and opaque note/backplate interior are acceptable on actual white/cyan/alpha inspection; alpha 254 is not itself a defect. Rejection is for the visible long-bar and repeated-mark RGB replacement in the note.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact textile motifs and individual note glyphs are not fully resolvable at 65x67; the rejection is for clearly visible changed grouping and a long uniform bar, not guessed writing.
